title: ICM Handoff Envelope
description: Wrapper around every payload that crosses a specialist boundary. All 10 handoffs in this system use this envelope. The payload shape is defined per-schema in this folder.

case_id.description: Stable ID for the full transaction thread. Set ONCE at orchestrator on first contact. Never changes. Every handoff in this case carries the same case_id from first lead to close.

handoff_id.description: Unique ID for this handoff. Used for tracing and escalation references.

from.description: Folder name of the sending specialist.

to.description: Folder name of the receiving specialist.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this handoff was created.

trigger.description: Plain-English reason this handoff fired. E.g. 'All qualifying fields captured, buyer pre-approved, timeline confirmed.'

agent_owner.description: Which human agent owns this thread. Set by orchestrator on first routing decision. Never changes mid-thread.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Increment to v2 when breaking changes are made.

ghl_contact_id.description: GoHighLevel contact ID. Ties every handoff back to the CRM record.

payload.description: Payload shape is defined in the corresponding schema file for this handoff type. See _schemas/ for all payload schemas.
